balls.text: Dube finishes with a boundary, and CSK end up with 209! Missed yorker outside off. Dube gets under this and slams it over mid on, who was placed very straight. One bounce and into the fence, and CSK will enter the second innings with some momentum on their side!
off the inside edge, but CSK will not care one bit! Low full toss outside off. Dube swings his blade like an axe and the ball flies away through the vacant fine leg region!
full, wide and this time too, it works for the bowler. Dube opens his bat face and guides it straight to backward point
full and wide outside off again. This might be just inside the tramlines. Dube swishes at it with all his might and misses
off the toe-end, but it still hits the fence! In the slot outside off. Dube winds up but because he has to fetch it from so far out, he does not middle it. Still muscles it enough to long on's left!

length ball hidden wide outside off. Dube lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide. And we have another review. But no luck for PBKS this time. No real pre-ball movement from Dube and the ball is beyond the tramlines!
Dube pinches a bye! Sharp bumper on middle and leg. Veer swings like a rusty gate and misses. Dube, though, is alert enough to scamper through

full and beyond the tramlines on the off side again. Dube is standing outside off before letting it go. The wide is called but now, PBKS want to take a look. This could be a shrewd review. Dube has moved across, which means the tramlines have also shifted. Replays confirm the ball is just inside the new tramline, and the wide call has been reversed, rightly!
well outside off again. Another wide yorker gone wrong and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide

smartly done! Full ball on the pads and PBKS are feeling the effects of not bowling their overs on time. No one out on the fence behind square and Dube glances it past square leg to help himself to a boundary!
shortish and climbing through on middle. Veer is late on the pull and seems to glove it into his grille. That will not tickle...
short and wide outside off. Dube throws his hands at it and flat-bats it towards deep cover
full toss hung up wider outside off. Dube reaches out and drills it through point. Back for a couple of runs
clean strike! Bartlett goes for the wide yorker but errs on the shorter side. In the slot and Dube frees his arms to lift it over extra cover!
short outside off. Dube gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards deep cover
full and following the batter a touch outside leg. Veer drills it down the ground to long on

zipped in very full, just outside leg. Veer looks to repeat the dose but gets jammed on the boot this time. Impact and pitching may have just been outside leg but Jansen and Shreyas, buoyed by their earlier review, have taken this upstairs. No bat involved and Ball Tracking, as expected, shows the ball to be pitching outside leg. Veer survives!
first runs in the IPL for Veer! Shortish outside off. Veer walks across his stumps and even though this gets big on him, he manages to help it past short fine leg!
bashed into the track outside off. Dube reaches out for it and flat-bats it to long off
Dube goes big, and the ball flies! Right in the slot on middle and leg. Dube clears his front leg and smokes it over deep mid wicket!
short and well outside off. Dube lets it go and the umpire has to signal for a wide again
sharp short ball and this climbs through, finishing just outside off. Veer jumps around, trying to dab it fine but is too late on the stroke
welcomed with a short ball, angling into off from around the wicket. Veer sways out of the way

and the change in plan works! Hard length just outside off. Sarfaraz, aware of the field change, tries to muscle it down the ground. Cannot get the purchase he wants, though, and only musters the height he desires. Wadhera back-pedals from mid on and snares the chance. An enterprising cameo, but CSK will now need someone else to take them to 200!
this is sumptuous batting! Shortish outside off. Sarfaraz knows short third is in the ring and he plays the ball right under his eyes, slashing it between short third and the keeper!

the runs continue to flow! It does not matter anymore where these runs are coming from - it is that stage if the innings. Back of a length outside off. A bit of a wild hack and the ball flies off the top edge over the keeper!
stop that, Sarfaraz! Nonchalant and eclectically brilliant. Very full outside off. Sarfaraz waits deep in his crease and then, like he is offering catching practice, steers it square of short third!
full toss on middle and leg. Sarfaraz uses his wrists and shovels it towards deep backward square leg
deposited over the fence! Slower ball on a full length on leg. Sarfaraz marches down, holds his shot and wallops it over deep backward square leg!
sprays this a mile outside off. Sarfaraz, having advanced, leaves it alone and gets the wide call
very full outside off. Dube jams down on it and digs it out towards long off
slower ball banged in short outside off. Dube hops up onto his toes and dabs it gently towards backward point
full and hung up wide outside off. Dube reaches out for it and inside-edges it towards the keeper
fullish on the pads. Dube sticks to the risk-free approach and clips it between deep mid wicket and long on for a brace
slower bumper outside off. Dube waits for it before tugging it towards deep mid wicket
slower ball that ends up as a low full toss outside off. Driven out to sweeper cover
four more! Not sure how much in control Sarfaraz was. Back of a length just outside off and this rears up. Sarfaraz plays with soft hands and then glides it between short third and the keeper!
that is a Sarfaraz special! Banged in short and honing into leg. Sarfaraz works out the angle early, arches his back and ramps it over the keeper!
glorious way to get off the mark! Back of a length outside off. Sarfaraz dances down, stands tall and thumps it over mid off!
dug in short just outside off. Dube rocks back, rolls his wrists and helps it down to fine leg
back of a length, angling into off. Sarfaraz lets the ball come to him before defending
slower ball on a length on middle and off. Sarfaraz comes forward and nudges it towards mid wicket

big lbw appeal, and Jansen wants the review. And he gets the review too! Speared in full on middle stump. Kartik gets down low and swipes across the line. Gets rapped in front and this could spell trouble for him. Was it doing too much, though, especially with the angle from around the wicket? Flat line on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking comes up and...it shows the ball to be thundering into the inside of leg stump. Kartik has to go, and PBKS keep chipping away!
slower ball on a full length on the pads. Tucked away to deep backward square leg
right up in the blockhole on leg stump. Dube jams it out enough to long on's left and dashes back for a brace
full on the pads. Dube rolls his wrists and flicks it between long on and deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
hard length on middle and leg. Dube bunts it into the mid wicket region and keeps strike
back of a length outside off. Kartik opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third

back of a length delivery sliding down leg. Kartik seems to miss it, having gotten inside the line. The umpire does not call it a wide and Kartik takes it upstairs. There is a very minute murmur on UltraEdge, though, and the third umpire says it is enough to suggest the ball grazed the trouser. CSK burn a review!

goneski! Straight to short third, and Mhatre departs! Very full and very wide again. Mhatre jams down on it, while opening his bat face. Gets under this one, though, and the ball flies through to Chahal. Mhatre is livid with himself; Vyshak, absolutely delighted. PBKS with two wickets in quick succession!

Mhatre peppers the off side again! This is brilliant batting again. Full, wide and just the plan Vyshak wants to bowl to. Mhatre, though, gets those fast hands through the ball and cracks it past point!
back of a length on middle and leg. Dube hops up onto his toes and tucks it towards deep square leg
low dipping full toss outside off. Dube has to fetch it and he clinks it off the toe-end towards long on
speared in very full but also down leg. Dube lets it go again and gets the wide. Free hit continues
flighted up full outside off. Mhatre gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards long off. And uh-oh, Chahal has overstepped...
full and sneaking down leg. Dube lets it go and the keeper fumbles, meaning Mhatre can pinch a run
fullish and into the pads. Dube sweeps it straight to short fine leg

in the air, and shelled again! Mhatre survives! Floated up full just outside off. Mhatre skips down and swings for the hills. Slices it horribly and Shashank, tearing in from deep cover, slides in and puts it down. Could not control his momentum on the slide and Mhatre stays!
oh! Ripping leg-break. On a length on leg and this spins away appreciably. Mhatre gets squared up and has to defend
flighted up full outside off. Dube stretches forward and pushes it to long off

Gaikwad perishes trying to attack! On a length and sliding down leg. Gaikwad brings out the sweep but cannot quite free his arms as much as he would have wanted. Hits it well but straight to Wadhera at deep backward square leg. Gaikwad throws his head back in disappointment, and it is that man Chahal with the breakthrough again!

well well! Full ball hung up well beyond the tramlines on the off side. Mhatre shuffles across, initially shaping for the scoop. Changes his mind mid-way and then attempts the reverse-lap. Misses it and does not get the wide either
clever batting! More or less the perfect wide yorker but Mhatre's shot is just too good. He opens his bat face and steers it between deep backward point and short third!
hard length outside off. Gaikwad stands tall and punches it to long on
slanted in full on the stumps. Gaikwad uses the angle and clips it between long on and deep mid wicket. Back for another brace
very full outside off. Mhatre clinks it out into the off side and picks up another run
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad jabs it towards backward point and turns the strike over
tossed up full on middle and leg. Gaikwad gives himself a bit of room and knocks it to long off
fired in full on the pads. Gaikwad tucks it between deep mid wicket and long on, and ambles back for a brace
slowed up again, on a fullish length on middle and off. Mhatre loses his shape trying to slog it over cow corner and chunks it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
shortish outside off. Mhatre goes back and across before slapping it over extra cover. Shashank tumbles to his right on the fence and reins it in

loops up, and put down! Chahal gives it lots of air on a length on leg stump. Mhatre is early on the sweep and the ball pops up off the leading edge. Vyshak lunges forward from short fine but cannot make it stick
flighted up full on the stumps. Gaikwad comes forward and flicks it to long on
banged in short outside off and this zips through. Mhatre is late on the pull and the ball whistles past his flailing blade
shortish outside off. Gaikwad hangs back and pulls it to long on

back of a length on middle and leg. Gaikwad bunts it into the mid wicket region and calls for two. Mhatre has to scramble but he makes it, despite Stoinis' efforts to chase the ball down and hurl a throw at the bowler's end
low full toss outside off. Mhatre shanks it down the ground to long on. Mistimed it so badly that it barely crossed the ring
back of a length delivery hung up wide outside off. Mhatre bails out of the stroke at the last moment and gets the wide
back to back sixes, and Mhatre is ripping the Kings apart! Another slot ball outside off. Mhatre sets up a solid base and pumps it over the bowler's head!

Mhatre gets to fifty in stunning style! Off-pace but this lands in the slot outside off. Mhatre swings through the line and launches it over long off. Beaming smile on the youngster's face but his job may not be done yet!
slider on a length on off. Mhatre stays leg side of the ball and jams it out towards sweeper cover
flighted up full on middle and off. Gaikwad gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long off
back of a length outside off. Mhatre stays back and jabs it towards sweeper cover
back of a length on middle and leg. Gaikwad stays back and punches it to long on
slipped in quicker and fuller on middle and leg. Mhatre knocks it uppishly towards long on
tossed up full on middle and off. Gaikwad gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg
yorker on middle and off. Mhatre picks it just in time and squeezes it out towards extra cover
oh, this is going to bring rain! And beyond the ropes again! Change of pace but this is in the slot on middle and off. Mhatre lines it up and smears it over wide long on!
back of a length on middle and leg. Mhatre gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid wicket
angled in on a fullish length on off. Mhatre jams it past extra cover and has enough time to hurtle back for two
length ball pushed across the batter outside off. Mhatre has a wild swish at it and does not lay bat on ball
into the stands again! This boy can play! Banged half-way down on leg. Mhatre picks it up and then dumps it way over the deep square leg fence!
another yorker, just outside off. Mhatre chalks it off the toe-end towards mid on and has to settle for a single
into the blockhole again, just outside off. Mhatre gets his bat down in time and plinks it back to the bowler
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad opens his bat face and guides it down to deep backward point
in-swinging yorker on off. Mhatre jams it out to mid off and canters across to the other end
Mhatre continues to motor along! Right in the slot outside off and Mhatre says thank you very much. He swings through the line and bangs it over his skipper's head!
short and sneaking down leg. Mhatre swings and misses, and then sees the umpire stretch out his arms
full and shaping in slightly into the stumps. Mhatre tries to hit it too hard and drags it to mid wicket
shortish on middle and leg. Mhatre gets his front hip out of the way and heaves it towards deep backward square leg
dug in short outside off and this keeps a touch low. Mhatre has a whoosh across the line but only connects with fresh air. Might have been a change-up
hard length, tucking up the batter on middle and off. Mhatre swings at it anyway and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket
this is a terrific hit! Slower bumper on middle and leg, and Mhatre, for a moment, forgets what sport he is playing. Channels his inner Novak Djokovic and forehands it well over the long on fence!
pushed in on a length on leg. Mhatre plays all around it and gets pinged on the pad. No chance of an lbw, though - sliding well down
back of a length on off. Gaikwad lets the ball come to him before dabbing it to deep backward point
fullish in the channel and this leaves the batter. Mhatre jabs at it and slices it towards backward point
another short ball, although this may have been just outside off. Mhatre stands tall and slugs it over the bowler's head. Arshdeep seems to do just enough to stop it at long on

three fours in a row, and Chepauk finds its voice! Banged in short on the stumps. Mhatre spots the length early, opens his front hip enough and heaves it over mid wicket. Too far to deep square leg's left to be able to rein it in!
much better contact this time! This is fuller and slanting into the pads. Mhatre snaps his wrists into action and whips it over mid wicket!
up and over! Mhatre finally gets one away. In the slot outside off. Mhatre gets his front foot out of the way and muscles it over mid on!
back of a length on middle and leg. Gaikwad uses the angle and tucks it off his pads towards long leg
full outside off. Mhatre sits deep in his crease and drills it straight to mid off
shortish outside off. Seems like another cutter and Mhatre, having waited for it, jabs it towards extra cover
no one is stopping this, though! Full and well down leg. Swings down further and Prabhsimran cannot get enough of his gloves to it. Five bonus runs!
slower ball on a fullish length on off. Mhatre goes searching for it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards the bowler
back of a length on middle and leg. Mhatre stays a little leg side of the ball before defending
back of a length on leg. Gaikwad drops it into the on side and saunters across to the other end
short, wide and punished! Sits up outside off and Gaikwad gets on top of the bounce nicely. Cracks it in front of point and the sweeper cannot cut it off to his right, despite a dive!

nicked and gone this time! Samson falls for 7 on his home debut! Length ball on middle and off, and this swerves away at the last moment. Samson backs away, looking to go inside-out but the ball is not full enough to drive. Gets a healthy nick and Prabhsimran does the rest behind the stumps. Chepauk is shocked, and CSK lose a wicket early in the piece yet again!
this is some shot! Back of a length outside off. Similar movement away from him but he covers the line much better. Steps forward, stands tall and bashes it on the up to mid off's left!
oh! Length ball outside off and this curves away late. Samson has a flay at it away from his body and only grabs a handful of fresh air
length outside off. Gaikwad gets onto the front foot and punches it enough to cover point's left for a single
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad has a more tentative poke at this and jams it off the inside edge into his pad
lovely! Fullish outside off and Gaikwad climbs into it. He leans forward, shows the full face and threads it between extra cover and cover point!
shortish on middle and off. Samson gets up on his toes and pats it into the mid wicket region
peach! Back of a length in the channel and this seams away. Skips off the surface too and Samson, nibbling at it, is beaten all ends up!
length outside off. Goes on with the angle and Gaikwad opens his bat face to run it down to deep backward point
length on middle and leg. Shapes in and Gaikwad, falling across slightly, plays around his front pad to stab it to mid wicket
top work on the fence! Back of a length on the pads. Samson times it sweetly through square leg. Shashank runs around from behind square, puts in the dive and saves a run
fuller on off, shaping into Samson. He takes a step down the track before prodding it towards mid wicket
back of a length delivery sliding down leg. Samson does not get bat on it and the umpire has to indulge in some early exercise

that will do it! A thundering blow to wrap up a commanding run-chase! Kamboj misses the yorker on the shorter side. On off and Stoinis blasts it over the bowler's head. Muted celebrations from those in the PBKS camp. This was another stellar run-chase and the best part about it, from a PBKS perspective, was that it never really seemed in doubt!
zipped in full on the pads. Shashank whips it towards deep backward square leg

short and sliding a shade down leg. Shashank gets inside the line and misses his swipe. Called a wide and CSK, after a bit of thought, have reviewed. They might have a case here. Third umpire says the batter was in his normal stance. No bat involved either, meaning the wide call remains!
full ball on the pads. Shashank works it into the deep square leg region and canters back for two
that is a stunning shot! Low full toss wide outside off. Shashank opens his bat face and scorches it through backward point!
low full toss outside off. Shashank drives it to sweeper cover and keeps strike
more runs over short third! Full outside off. Shashank swishes at it with pure abandon and musters a thick outside edge that clears the fielder in the ring!
in the air but safe! Slot ball laced with width. Shashank takes a step across and chips it over extra cover. Back for a brace
full toss outside off. Stoinis taken aback a touch and he scuffs it back to the bowler, who leaps to his left and parries it to long off
first-ball boundary for Stoinis! Full and hidden a mile outside off. Stoinis chases after it and gets a thick enough outside edge to beat short third to his right!

oh, hello! Oh, hello! This game may not be done just yet! Hung up full and wide. Wadhera skips down and throws his hands at it. Cannot control his waft, though, and he slices it straight to Noor at extra cover. Chepauk erupts, and CSK may just have a sniff here!

straight to the sweeper, and Kamboj has another! Is it too little, too late, though? Full and wide outside off. Shreyas reaches out and gets a good chunk of it too. Not a good enough chunk to clear the fence, however, and Chahar accepts the offering with glee at sweeper cover!
hard length, slanted across the batter just outside off. Shreyas tries to smash it into the Bay of Bengal, but does not make any contact

how has that missed?! Kamboj spears in a leg-stump yorker and it nearly catches Shreyas off-guard. The batter had moved across and then missed his flick. An extra coat of paint and leg stump may have been pegged back. But all of that might have been immaterial because Kamboj has overstepped...

finds the fence this time, and Shreyas brings up another half-century as PBKS skipper! Full and wide again. Shreyas throws the plumbing at it and slices it over short third. A 26-ball fifty for the captain!

did that carry?! Another wide yorker. Shreyas jams down on it and squeezes it out towards short third. Not sure if that carried, or if it was a bump ball. Not a bump ball, and it may just have carried to Henry!

full and wide outside off. Shreyas tries to reach out for it and fails to do so. He reckons it is wide enough to be an extra, and he reviews. Could be touch-and-go. Shreyas did not move across his stumps as such, meaning the tramlines would not have shifted a lot. Replays, though, suggest Shreyas did take a step across. The ball is well inside the revised guideline and the original call stays!
slot ball and punished! On middle and leg, and Shreyas clears his front leg to batter it to deep mid wicket's left!
googly floated up on a fullish length outside off. Wadhera has a wild mow at it and misses it
lobbed up full outside off. Driven down the ground to long off
speared in on a length but beyond the tramlines on the off side. Some more exercise for the umpire
googly on a back of a length outside off. Wadhera loads up and shanks it to long on
going, going, gone! Chahar errs on the fuller side now. Dishes out a slot ball on the stumps and Wadhera feasts, hoisting it over long on!
flighted up full on middle and leg. Shreyas comes forward and knocks it to long on
more runs, and PBKS are eating into this target significantly now! Not great bowling, it must be said. Too short, too wide and Shreyas crashes it through point!
full toss on the stumps. Shreyas closes his bat face too early and chunks it off the leading edge towards sweeper cover
pick the bones out of this too! This is a proper half-tracker outside off. Shreyas spots it early, sits deep in his crease and clatters it over deep mid wicket!
easy pickings for Shreyas! Banged half-way down and laced with ample width. Shreyas throws his hands at it and carves it over short third!
even fuller outside off. Shreyas digs it out towards extra cover
much fuller outside off. Shreyas presses forward and drives it to long off, where Dube fumbles again and concedes another run
banged in short outside off. Shreyas stands up on his toes and swats it between deep mid wicket and long on for a couple of runs
back of a length on off and this skids through. Wadhera prods it back to the bowler
fullish outside off. Shreyas gets a decent stride in and pushes it towards sweeper cover
googly on a back of a length outside off. Wadhera hangs back and dabs it towards backward point
fired in full on the pads. Shreyas nudges it towards deep square leg
another googly on a back of a length but this is wider outside off. Left alone and called a wide
back of a length outside off. Shreyas shapes for the cut but only swishes at thin air

more running confusion, but Wadhera survives! Full outside off. Wadhera slices it towards backward point. Original call is for wait but a fumble makes Shreyas want the run. Wadhera late to respond and he would have been well short with a direct hit. Dube the fielder
six more! Dragged down on middle and leg. Shreyas has all the time in the world to rock back and bosh it over deep mid wicket!
full just outside off. Eased down the ground to long off
quicker but similarly full outside off. Shreyas jabs at it and edges it down to short third
this is Shreyas at his best! Floated up full and wide. Shreyas gets his hands through the ball beautifully and caresses it over extra cover!
fuller outside off. Shreyas winds up and powers it down the ground to long on
back of a length on middle and leg. Shreyas stays back and pokes it towards mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Wadhera gets up on his toes and dabs it to backward point

holes out to long off, and the crowd comes alive again! Full toss just outside off. Connolly tries to smash it down the ground but the bat face opens upon contact. A bit of a slice in the end and Connolly could not have picked out Henry better. CSK still in this!
this is batting of the highest order! Full, wide and Connolly has telegraphed the line. He shimmies across and laps it between square leg and short fine!
dug in short just outside off. Shreyas lifts up his front leg Calypso style and pulls it to deep square leg
short outside off. Gets a little big on Connolly and he splices it towards long off
short, wide and too easy for Connolly! The Aussie youngster frees his arms and slashes it over backward point!
fizzed in full on leg. Shreyas content to come forward and block
shortish and tucking up the batter on leg. Short-arm-jabbed to deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Connolly opens up his stance and chips it over the bowler's head for a couple of runs
back of a length just outside off, and Connolly produces another top shot! Waits on the cut yet again and knifes it behind point. And Noor has overstepped too, and that adds to CSK's woes!
back of a length on leg. Shreyas goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket
safe! Tossed up full outside off. Connolly looks to go downtown and shanks it on the bounce to long on
shot! Back of a length outside off. Connolly sits deep in his crease and plays it very late, scything it behind point for four!
googly on a length on leg. Connolly plonks it off the leading edge into the cover region
smashed! Floaty full ball on middle and leg. Connolly gets his front foot out of the way and slugs it over the bowler's head!
back of a length on leg. Shreyas goes back and tucks it towards deep backward square leg
googly tossed up full on leg. Connolly gets down on one knee and drags it towards deep mid wicket
slider on a length just outside off. Connolly shapes for the cut but is too late on it
flighted up full outside off. Shreyas goes through the line and drives it towards sweeper cover
slanted in full on middle. Pushed out towards extra cover

oh dear - that is a terrible mix-up and CSK have a wicket out of nothing! Back of a length on off. Prabhsimran dinks it into the mid wicket region. Prabhsimran wants two and sets off, even with Noor chasing after it. In the end, Noor fumbles and that allows Sarfaraz to walk onto the ball and hurl a throw at the bowler's end. Prabhsimran, in the meantime, has run half-way down the track, only to be sent back. Nowhere in the frame, and PBKS have lost both their openers!
shortish on off. Connolly hangs back and flat-bats it to long on
back of a length on off. Prabhsimran goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket
full and wide outside off. Connolly goes chasing after it and squirts it off the inside edge past the keeper
shortish outside off. Prabhsimran gets on top of the bounce and punches it past cover point. Kamboj tears across to his right from deep point and saves a run
that is some shot! On the shorter side and sitting up outside off. Connolly reads the length and the googly early and carves it over extra cover!
sliced but safe! Hung up on a length outside off. Grips in the surface and spins away, with Prabhsimran miscuing it on the bounce to deep backward point
back of a length on leg. Skids through and Connolly bunts it into the mid wicket region
back of a length on the stumps. Prabhsimran stays back and knocks it to long on

another lbw shout, not given! Zipped in very full just outside off. Prabhsimran looks for the reverse again but picks a very full ball. Gets struck on the pad but the impact may have been a tad outside the line
dragged down outside off. Connolly flat-bats it to long on
shot! Fired in full on middle and off. Prabhsimran unfurls the reverse and nails it between backward point and short third!
fuller outside off. Prabhsimran gets forward and pushes it towards extra cover
googly on a length on middle and off. Prabhsimran looks for the sweep and misses it. Seems to get hit near the helmet
picked up and dumped over the fence! A touch short on off and that is all Prabhsimran needs. He rocks back and shovels it over deep mid wicket!
googly on a back of a length on middle and leg. Punched down the ground to long on
length ball on the pads. Prabhsimran tucks it towards deep backward square leg
hard length on off. Hurries onto Connolly, who shanks it down the ground to mid off
back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran sits deep in his crease and scuffs it towards extra cover

back of a length outside off and this hurtles through. Prabhsimran wafts at it and misses. Khaleel is hell-bent that he has heard something and Gaikwad, eventually, lets the clock run out. UltraEdge confirms there was no bat involved!
back of a length delivery wide outside off. Prabhsimran has an old-fashioned slog across the line and only swats away a few flies in the process
much better shape, and a much better result for PBKS! Slower ball on a length outside off. Prabhsimran holds his shot and then lofts it over extra cover!
back of a length just outside off. Prabhsimran dashes down the track, swishes in an ungainly manner and misses
angled in full on middle and off. Prabhsimran punches it on the bounce to mid off, who fumbles and ends up conceding a single

massive, massive lbw shout, and Henry likes it very much. CSK review! Zipped in very full on leg. Prabhsimran has a swish at it and plays all around it. Gets struck on the back leg but this might just be sneaking down. No bat involved, and on second glance, this could be close. Ball Tracking comes up and shows the ball to be clipping the outside of leg stump. Umpire's Call, and Prabhsimran stays!
back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran's turn to have a wild hack and he too misses
back of a length, pitching just outside leg and skidding through. Connolly plays all around it and the ball pings off the back leg into the off side

off stump flat on the ground! Henry roars, and Chepauk roars in unison! Hard length on middle and leg, and this seems to nip away a shade. Arya hares down and swipes at it without a care in the world. Misses the ball completely and sees his off stump in a mess. An 11-ball 39 for Arya, but CSK finally have the wicket they were craving!
does not make a difference to Arya, though! Length ball on middle and leg. Arya plants his front foot and pounds it over the bowler's head!
ripper to end the over! Back of a length outside off. Kisses the surface and zips through. Prabhsimran, wafting at it, is beaten for pace
full outside off. Prabhsimran gets forward and drives it uppishly towards mid off. Not far from Kamboj but he never really had a chance
over the top again! Full and too much width on offer. Prabhsimran throws the kitchen sink at it and flays it over point!
back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran gets on top of the bounce before dabbing it to backward point
this is a hitting clinic! Slot ball outside off. Prabhsimran walks across his stumps and slams it over the bowler's head!
bursts through the hands! Very full outside off. Prabhsimran jams it into the pitch and the ball sizzles through Kamboj's palms. Too hot to handle!

in the air, in the air, and just over! On the shorter side again, just outside off. Arya sets himself up and shovels it a mile up. Deep square leg is interested for a long time but sees the ball creep over his right shoulder in the end!
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran waits on it and cuts it towards deep backward point
back of a length just outside off. Prabhsimran has a huge swing at it and misses
shortish just outside off. Arya stabs it to mid wicket and saunters across to the other end
length on middle and off. Prabhsimran hangs back and drops it into the extra cover region
full and shaping into the pads. Flicked straight to mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran opens his bat face and slices it down to deep backward point
four more! This is ordinary bowling. Shortish and angling into the hips. Prabhsimran uses the pace and helps it past short fine leg!
back of a length on off. Arya taps it into the wide mid on region and picks up a single
Arya is on a rampage early! Length just outside off. Arya plants his front foot and thrashes it between extra cover and mid off!
that is right in Arya's wheelhouse! Dragged down outside off and Arya is sweating on the pull. He rocks back and pummels it over mid wicket!
edged and four! Back of a length outside off. Arya throws his hands at it and the ball hurtles off the outside edge between the keeper and short third!
this is a peach! Pushed across the batter on a length outside off. Prabhsimran goes feeling for it and is beaten comprehensively!
full and angled across the batter outside off. Prabhsimran wafts at it and misses. Umpire thinks it is wide enough to indulge in some more exercise
length ball sprayed way outside off. Prabhsimran lets it go and Samson does really well to get his right glove to it. Saved four there
jaffa! Much fuller outside off and swerving away late. Prabhsimran has a loose poke at it and gets beaten on the outside
out-swinger, on a length outside off. Prabhsimran gets forward and defends
back of a length on the pads. Arya tucks it towards deep square leg
Arya goes big now! Marginally short just outside off and Arya is all over it like a rash. He stands up tall and whacks it over mid wicket!
shot! Curving in on a length on middle and leg. Arya comes forward, shows the maker's name and blitzes it back past the bowler!
back of a length delivery sliding down leg. Arya seems to miss it and Samson fails to gather cleanly too. Called a wide
